0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 1-2 at home) host the San Antonio Spurs (2-2) in the fifth game of the season for Utah, with the Jazz on a two-game losing streak and 13th in the West, while the Spurs are on a two-game winning streak and 7th in the West. Utah is 5th in the Northwest, 3 games back, and San Antonio is 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Jazz lost 1-2 to the Spurs in 2025-26, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026. Out for Utah are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (wrist), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
